items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Jim McNeely and I are the music directors at the BMI Jazz Composers Workshop.

ctx.x: Yeah. And sometimes — I did this one thing for seven trombones for the Metropole Orchestra in the Netherlands. A wonderful orchestra, it was for a big trombone festival two years ago. And seven trombones plus the full orchestra which is about 70 musicians. So it was kind of a difficult piece. Each trombone player gave me an original and I had to write about an hour’s piece of music locking all these things together. So I’m like sitting on — I know I have a deadline. I work better as the deadline gets closer. You…
Do you have your own room at home?
